name: Kaluga Oblast
summary_text: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which found no region-specific trans-related evidence for it: hostility here is legislated federally and administered by federal security services, so the division inherits the national picture (score 0.12; deviation vs national ±0.02). The federal layer applying here: the 2023 ban on legal gender recognition and gender-affirming care; the propaganda law (up to 15 days' detention plus deportation for foreign visitors who 'promote' non-traditional relationships); the 'LGBT extremism' designation regime (101 convictions, 146 fines in 2024); and uncorrectable document markers, so any police, hotel or transport identity check reads a mismatch.
